{{Quote|The sky was full of them as they descended upon us. I wondered if our men on the ground would think us brave fools, or just fools.|Excerpt from the Eyewitness Report of Lieutenant Blair|<ref name="Date" />}}
The '''Battle of Slotern''' was a short skirmish at the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Slotern]] sometime<ref name="TIE" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The engagement was fought between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and [[Unidentified resistance group|resistance fighter]] craft and ground forces that resulted in a victory for the Galactic Empire. The TIE [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] engaged the resistance's ancient starfighters and, in the first pass, destroyed all but two of the craft, which were [[Pilot/Legends|flown]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Blair]] and his [[Unidentified wingman|wingman]].<ref name="TIE" />

The TIEs formed into packs and made another sweep to finish off the enemy forces in a second pass. The TIEs destroyed one of the two last remaining fighter craft and damaged the other one, piloted by Lieutenant Blair. He then dove toward the ground, but the fighter's automatic ejection activated, making Blair the sole survivor of the resistance fighters. In an Eyewitness Report, Blair stated that the battle lasted only two [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="TIE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Slotern was mentioned in the "TIE fighter" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="TIE" />
